verdict.rationale: Phaser has hosted services, including accounts, the Phaser Game Agent and a hosted MCP endpoint, so data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, documents no retention settings, deletion controls or data-handling policy. The nearest items are licence transfer and moving project files to VS Code, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
